title: What's Wrong with Patel? The Numbers Behind the Slump
summary: Usman Patel's average has dropped from 25.4 to 5.9 in recent innings — a 20-point decline.
body:
## The Decline

Usman Patel is going through a rough patch. His recent 10-innings average of **5.9** is a far cry from his career mark of **25.4**.

| Period | Average | Strike Rate |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| Career | 25.4 | 130.3 |
| Last 10 | 5.9 | 89.4 |

The question facing his team: is this a temporary blip or a deeper problem?
